limits: Disconnected matroids are excluded because the affine dimension can drop.
Higher intrinsic volumes and arbitrary affine transformations are not covered.
Historical priority under alternative terminology is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_integrity: An analytical disjoint-corner argument proves additivity; numerical convex-hull checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Connected sparse-paving matroid base polytopes with n>=4 and 2<=r<=n-2 in the canonical incidence-vector Euclidean embedding; intrinsic boundary (n-2)-measure.

title: Euclidean surface area of sparse-paving matroid base polytopes depends only on their nonbases
